title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity | TechCrunch
summary: Zuckerberg said about 25% of people who set up Muse now use it daily, helping improve retention. Beyond shopping, Zuckerberg said other popular uses for Muse include personal productivity tasks, such as connecting the AI agent to users’ email or calendars.
